mu_name_from: MuPlayer.PartsForClass in the old client: the body a class wears with no armour equipped is HelmClass{NN}, ArmorClass{NN}, PantClass{NN}, GloveClass{NN}, BootClass{NN}, numbered one over MU's zero-based classes. Class01 is the Dark Wizard, Class02 the Dark Knight, Class03 the Elf.
part_note: The legs, 160 triangles. Bound to 30 on Bip01 R Thigh, 30 on Bip01 L Thigh, 17 on Bip01 Pelvis, 8 on Bip01 Spine, 6 on Bip01 R Calf, 6 on Bip01 L Calf.
sheet_from: Data/Player/HQSkinClass102.OZJ (256x256), from the Season 17 client (third_party/MuClient_S17_v1.19.74). All five of the Dark Knight's parts name it.
model_from: Season 17's remake of MU's Dark Knight body, read out of Data/Player/PantClass02.bmd in the S17 client: a version-14 file, which MuExtract opens through Webzen's ModulusCryptor (pipeline/MuExtract/MuAssets/Crypto). It replaced MuMain's PantClass02 on 2026-10-15 at the user's call ("now DK and BK", after the Dark Wizard and Soul Master). Its 51 bones are the first 51 of player.bmd's, by name and order, so it rides our rig and clips as MuMain's did.
material_note: cloth, the whole of it: one shell of trouser.
